name: CMD.exe
description: cmd is the Windows command-line interpreter that can be used to interact with systems and execute other processes and utilities.
summary: Copy files to/from a remotely connected internal system
Execute programs and other actions at the command-line interface
Find information about the operating system
Copy files to/from a remotely connected external system
Delete files from the file system
Find files and directories with native functionality such as dir commands
